ike: Ike is United States general who supervised the invasion of Normandy and the defeat of Nazi Germany.
Ike means the same as Eisenhower or Dwight Eisenhower or Dwight D. Eisenhower.
ikhanaton: Ikhanaton is early ruler of Egypt who rejected the old gods and replaced them with sun worship.
Ikhanaton means the same as Akhenaton or Akhenaten or Amenhotep IV.
ikon: An ikon is a visual representation produced on a surface.
For example: "They showed us the pictures of their wedding."
Ikon can also mean a conventional religious painting in oil on a small wooden panel.
Ikon means the same as picture or image or icon.
